meta.source: Per-instrument starting points: show-weighted medians of real FOH and monitor DiGiCo sessions (aggregate values only; no session, show or channel names are kept).

units.freq_hz: Hz as shown on the strip (HPF = stored x 1.25, LPF = stored x 0.8)
units.eq band: UI band 1-4 (file band byte = 4 - UI band)

rules.in: a processor is on in the template when >= 50% of the show-weighted channels use it
rules.eq_band: an EQ band is in the template when >= 40% of channels have it active (|gain| >= 0.5 dB or dynamic); freq/gain/Q are medians of the dominant sign (cut or boost) and shape
rules.values: medians over channels that use the processor, each show weighted 1 (split across its channels)
rules.hpf_used: HPF in and above 21 Hz; lpf_used: LPF in and below 19.5 kHz
rules.mustard: Mustard stats come only from Quantum sessions (Q2/Q3/Q5); SD-series files have no Mustard modules
rules.thin: fewer than 5 channels or fewer than 3 shows: use the fallback category

taxonomy.normalise: lower case; every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] becomes one space; trim

rules.regex: \bfx \d+ rt\b|\bfx vox rtn\b|\bacu fx\b|\binst fx\d?\b|\bfx rt\b

taxonomy.floor_tom: numbered toms only (T1/T2, Tom 1/Tom 2) and no explicit floor tom in the file: the highest number is the floor tom

write_keys.note: (module, param, band) for ses.Session.set(ch, module, param, band, value); convert display -> stored

model: 0 classic, 3 vca, 4 fet, 5 optical, 8 leveling amp

hand_perc.label: Hand percussion (cajon, djembe, conga, washboard, porch board)

vocal_generic.label: Vocal, role not named (BGV or shared lead)
